text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How's that, Scarlet!! Heheh, we're still in different leagues!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Unbelievable!
She should've burned out long ago...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What is with this hidden reservoir of strength!?
It defies all common sense...

Vodka wins. The dead heat between the two
had reached a far higher level than in the spring.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you've really built up your stamina...
I always knew you had more than me, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... she doesn't even show a hint of fatigue.
Just what kind of training did she go through?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I just did steady distance running. Morning, noon, and night,
in the smartest way possible, and more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's it? Boring.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right, it's boring! But I made sure to do that absolute most boring part properly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "That is—my weapon. Something you definitely don't have, and something you could never do."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll hone this and beat you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Lost, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean eventually! It's still only the first race of the autumn season!
The argument continued for a while...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch next time! Year-end! The Arima Kinen!
2,500 meters suits my strengths much better.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Got it? The final winner gets
one million points and becomes the champion of the year!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What kind of nonsense is that?!
Is this some kind of rigged quiz show?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, before that,
I plan on entering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"If your schedule allows, come there too.
I'll take you on as many times as it takes."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Assuming you aren't scared of me, that is!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, those are pretty bold words for someone who lost.
Still—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me. I don't know about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
but the year-end Arima Kinen! That's where I'll read you
your last rites!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I'll be much stronger by then.
See ya!
Even in defeat, Daiwa Scarlet walked away with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this kind of thing
isn't half bad, is it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I compete against her, I forget everything
and just lose myself in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
And that ain't all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She probably sees it now.
Maybe even more clearly than I do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Nah, it's nothin'. Just let me face her in the Arima, will ya?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I'll be able to see what's truly important there.
For what lies ahead for me."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's head to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank you, Trainer.
Man, she's always so loud, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the rest of this year.
Let's turn this into an all-out match race.
